subject.title: fix: before_agent_run transform no longer leaks redacted text into history

question: Should `before_agent_run` gain a public `transform` outcome, and if so must its replacement become the canonical stored user turn rather than only model-bound text?
rationale: Current main supports only pass/block, while the earlier unmerged proposal explicitly preserved raw transcript text; choosing durable canonical redaction changes both the plugin API and transcript semantics.

options.title: Sponsor canonical redaction
options.body: Make the transformed prompt authoritative for model input, observers, and stored history while preserving recorder-owned message identity and metadata.

options.title: Keep model-only transformation
options.body: Preserve the raw canonical transcript and document that the hook shapes only the immediate model boundary, so it cannot be presented as durable redaction.

options.title: Do not add transform
options.body: Keep pass/block and design a separate dedicated redaction seam before exposing a public transcript-rewriting contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor canonical redaction
recommendation.body: Make the transformed prompt authoritative for model input, observers, and stored history while preserving recorder-owned message identity and metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice spans public plugin behavior and canonical transcript architecture, matching recent repository-level transcript ownership work.
